checklist_categories.name: Exterior & Body Panels
checklist_categories.description: Inspection of panels, paint, windshield, chrome badges, and mirrors

checklist_categories.name: Lighting & Electricals
checklist_categories.description: Headlamps, DRLs, taillights, blinkers, hazard, horn, and wiper motors

checklist_categories.name: Under-Hood & Fluid Levels
checklist_categories.description: Engine oil, coolant, brake fluid, battery health, wire harnesses

checklist_categories.name: Underbody, Wheels & Suspension
checklist_categories.description: Tyre pressure, tread, alloy condition, suspension, and underbody shield

checklist_categories.name: Interior Cabin & Dashboard
checklist_categories.description: Seat upholstery, dashboard, touch infotainment, AC cooling, power windows

checklist_categories.name: Boot, Tools & Safety Gear
checklist_categories.description: Spare wheel, jack, wheel spanner, warning triangle, parcel tray

checklist_categories.name: Brakes & Road Functionality
checklist_categories.description: Brake pedal feel, handbrake / EPB hold, steering response, gear shifting

checklist_categories.name: Documentation & Keys
checklist_categories.description: VIN plate verification, smart keys (2 keys), manual, warranty booklet

checklist_items.title: Panel Gaps & Flush Alignment
checklist_items.instructions: Check hood, doors, tailgate and bumper shutlines for uniform gap (3.5mm ± 0.5mm).

checklist_items.title: Paint Finish & Scratch Inspection
checklist_items.instructions: Inspect panels under daylight for transit scratches, clear-coat swirl marks or paint chips.

checklist_items.title: Windshield & Window Panes
checklist_items.instructions: Verify front windshield, rear glass, and window panes are crack-free and date-coded.

checklist_items.title: ORVM Power Fold & Adjustment
checklist_items.instructions: Test left and right mirror power folding motor and glass tilt adjustments.

checklist_items.title: LED DRLs & Headlamp High/Low Beam
checklist_items.instructions: Turn on low beam, high beam, projector lamps and fog lamps. Verify leveler.

checklist_items.title: Turn Indicators & Hazard Flashers
checklist_items.instructions: Verify front, mirror, and rear indicator LED sequences and hazard switch.

checklist_items.title: Tail Lamps & Connected Lightbar
checklist_items.instructions: Verify rear connected lightbar glow, high-mount stop lamp and reverse white lamps.

checklist_items.title: Dual Horn Sound & Pitch
checklist_items.instructions: Press horn pad on steering. Test dual trumpet tone output.

checklist_items.title: Engine Oil Level & Dipstick
checklist_items.instructions: Pull dipstick; verify oil level is between MIN and MAX marks. Oil clean and amber.

checklist_items.title: Coolant Reservoir Level
checklist_items.instructions: Check coolant expansion tank level (cold engine). Inspect for hose leaks.

checklist_items.title: Brake & Clutch Fluid Level
checklist_items.instructions: Verify master cylinder reservoir fluid level is at MAX mark.

checklist_items.title: 12V Battery Voltage Check
checklist_items.instructions: Measure open circuit terminal voltage with multimeter (target: >= 12.6V).

checklist_items.title: Tyre Pressure Calibration (PSI)
checklist_items.instructions: Measure and calibrate tyre pressure to manufacturer spec (33-36 PSI).

checklist_items.title: Alloy Wheels & Sidewall Condition
checklist_items.instructions: Inspect rims for kerb rash, rim dents, or tyre sidewall cuts/bulges.

checklist_items.title: Wheel Lug Nuts Torque
checklist_items.instructions: Check all 4 wheels lug nuts are torqued to specification (110 Nm).

checklist_items.title: Underbody Anti-Rust & Shield Inspection
checklist_items.instructions: Inspect underbody floor pan on ramp for scrape marks or missing clips.

checklist_items.title: Touchscreen Infotainment & Audio
checklist_items.instructions: Verify touch response, Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay / Android Auto, and speakers.

checklist_items.title: AC Cooling & Climate Control
checklist_items.instructions: Run AC at lowest temperature (16°C) for 3 minutes; verify blower & vent cooling.

checklist_items.title: All Power Windows & Central Lock
checklist_items.instructions: Test all 4 window switches for one-touch up/down and remote key lock.

checklist_items.title: Odometer Reading (KM)
checklist_items.instructions: Record odometer reading from instrument cluster (target: < 50 km).

checklist_items.title: Spare Wheel & Tool Kit Complete
checklist_items.instructions: Check presence of spare tyre, jack, tommy bar, spanner, and tow hook.

checklist_items.title: Emergency Warning Triangle & Medikit
checklist_items.instructions: Verify reflective safety triangle and first aid kit in boot compartment.

checklist_items.title: Foot Brake & EPB Auto-Hold
checklist_items.instructions: Test brake firmness, ABS bite, and electronic parking brake auto-hold.

checklist_items.title: Steering Centering & Tracking
checklist_items.instructions: Verify steering wheel is dead-center with zero pull during yard driving.

checklist_items.title: Chassis / VIN Plate Match
checklist_items.instructions: Match physical VIN stamped on driver B-pillar / engine bay with invoice.

checklist_items.title: 2 Smart Keys / Key Fobs Present
checklist_items.instructions: Test lock, unlock, and boot release buttons on both physical key fobs.
